items.title: The Illusion of Abundance: Record Home Equity’s Purchasing-Power Problem
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Since last fall, real property values have been declining at an annual rate of approximately 4 percent in Texas and 2 percent nationally.

items.title: Rising Property Tax Bills: Why Growth Is Not to Blame
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Economic growth expands the tax base, but increasing property tax bills are largely the result of local government spending.
